title: Independently audit the all-even attaining word and compatibility gate
body:
PR6717 section 7 claims an attaining construction for every even dimension and coupled width. This independent audit confirms the displayed construction within its algebraic contract and adds a control showing why checking the complete endpoint alone is insufficient.

At n=6, omitting the last column's alternating correction leaves the basis unimodular and preserves the entire formal endpoint, but the final stage fails compatibility: (I-Pn)Rn=(e4-e5)(e0^T+e3^T) != 0. The checker explicitly accepts that altered endpoint and rejects its incompatible query. This is outside the source theorem's hypotheses, not a counterexample to PR6717.

The isolated package contains:
- A self-contained all-n/all-q derivation of the source's ranks (2q,3q,2q), actual prefix conditions, and S diag(ABC,AB,B,C,I) endpoint, preserving all independent inputs.
- A new standard-library checker that imports no predecessor code and multiplies the literal full symbolic word.
- Exact retained source proof/notice/license, source pins, scoped task metadata, registered normal/optimized commands, and validation evidence.

**Evidence:** 18 finite cases pass, including coupled widths and odd finite characteristics. Four semantic fault controls reject. Normal/optimized output agrees; Git-free empty-PATH checks preserve all file bytes; source tampering is rejected in both modes. The committed-byte preflight passes all 10 files, and the replay planner selects exactly this package.

**Sources and coordination:** starts at current main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; exact source PR6717 `3c9072b8738323dda9f9c7dfb421d578ed3fc17a`. Takes the [unreviewed attainment handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19405518); [canonical claim and updates](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/6730). Fresh overlap covered 680 open PR bodies, 6,803 Discussion records and all 8,917 main note paths; limitations and source-head checks are recorded.

**Limits:** a written and executable construction audit, not proof-assistant formalization, independent human review, or proof of the universal 7q lower bound. Sections 2-6, physical/native realization, full paid invoice and all selected framework assumptions remain outside. No new kappa or selected-frontier change. The `formal-interface-lemma` card scope change is explicit.

Credit stays with thu-nmrc's construction, Ali Romman's normal-form/closure work, Cinna Davis's query/controller lineage and retained contributors. New audit/checker prepared for ferdy252 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate AI proof and static-code review. Apache-2.0.

Reproduce:
```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-attainment-independent-audit
```

Hosted CI: [run 41983373732](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41983373732) is `action_required` with zero jobs run at this head. Local checks passed; no hosted success is claimed.
